NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock your private tabs and saved passwords with Face ID.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Websites can ask to use the camera, for example to take a photo to upload. Signet also uses it to scan the code shown by your computer.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Websites can ask to use the microphone, for example for a video call or a voice message.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos and videos to upload to websites.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save images from websites to your photo library.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Websites can ask for your location while you use the app, for example a map or a store finder.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Find your computer on this Wi-Fi network to open the websites you are developing on it.
